## Source inspected
Chapter 4 of the Home and Community Care Policy Manual and the Ministry's policy-manual landing page were read on 6 October 2026. The chapter contains provisions with different effective dates. It is current administrative policy and a record of later revisions, not a recovered 1990s design file.
:::

## Annotation

Policy 4.C.1 describes CSIL as a self-directed home-support service that health authorities fund as an alternative to receiving health-authority-managed home support. It states that clients who cannot always direct their own care may still be able to participate through a client support group or a CSIL representative.

Definitions in the policy include a client support group incorporated as a non-profit society of family and/or friends, a CSIL representative designated through a valid representation agreement, and a CSIL employer that may be the client, client support group or representative. The policy also states that clients receiving CSIL funding as of 31 March 2011 remain eligible after 1 April 2011 regardless of later eligibility criteria.

The Ministry's revision history records a February 2021 update to clarify CSIL eligibility criteria. In the inspected chapter, Policy 4.C.2 is effective February 2021 and sets out assessment criteria including home-support need, interRAI HC ADL Long Form and MAPLe scores, high physical care needs, physical disability, medical stability, ability to coordinate and manage CSIL or use of a client support group or representative, and exception criteria. It states that diagnosis by itself does not constitute disability and ties the definition to functionality.

Policy 4.C.3 lists the following minimum hourly rates:

| Effective date | Minimum hourly rate |
| --- | ---: |
| 1 April 2022 | $34.73 |
| 1 April 2023 | $37.07 |
| 1 April 2024 | $38.19 |

The policy-manual landing page says the 2022, 2023 and 2024 amounts were added to Policy 4.C on 25 July 2023, and records a further 1 April 2024 update reflecting the confirmed one per cent cost-of-living allowance.

The current chapter does not establish every intermediate CSIL rate before April 2022. This archive therefore does not infer missing rate changes from the later table.
